Chapter Competition[edit]

For Oklahoma’s chapter competition, there are three distinct regions. Each region competes on a certain date.

  • East central: One to two weeks after central
  • Central: The first or second week of the first national chapter competitions
  • Southwestern: One to two weeks after central

The eastern region was eliminated in 2015. It is uncertain if it will come back in the future.

The most competitive of these 3 regions are the ones with Oklahoma's two major metropolis: east central (Tulsa) and central (Oklahoma City/Norman).

Around a third to a quarter of the top competitors from each chapter advance to state.

State Competition[edit]

State competition is usually held on the first weekend of March. Approximately 80-88 students compete each year. Countdown round is official. The 2026 Oklahoma State Competition was on March 7th, 2026 at Oklahoma City University.

National Competition[edit]

In the national competition, Oklahoma is usually ranked slightly below average, often scoring in the high 20s to mid 30s. The best Oklahoma has ever done was in the second MATHCOUNTS year, with a student, Timothy Kokesh, making first place individual and the Oklahoma team making 3rd.
